toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Search SAGE-connected stores and SAGE's verified public independent-retailer inventory network for a specific rare, vintage, discontinued, one-of-one, local, secondhand, or hard-to-find general-audience physical product. Results require fresh positive source evidence, a crawlable SAGE item page, and the underlying exact retailer source when fetched. When results is empty, show recovery.markdownLink to the shopper. Read-only: this tool cannot reserve, purchase, contact a retailer, or change inventory.

toolsPreview.name: fetch
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one exact result id returned by this public-network search. SAGE rechecks the indexed retailer evidence before returning its source, URL, price, freshness, availability evidence, and limits. Read-only; never use an id not returned by search.
